announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.19-l7 — operations and local usage
announcements.summary: Adds runtime diagnostics, safer integration visibility, and a vertical local Codex usage chart.
announcements.content:
This release improves Dashboard operations, optional integration safety, and local Codex usage visibility.
1. Operations: adds a runtime status panel for protocol, route, active turns, usage attribution, and last-check state.
2. Integration safety: hides or disables sharing and optional integration entry points when their services are unavailable or disabled.
3. Local usage: replaces daily text rows with a vertical bar chart, compact labels for every supported range, and fast hover details for each bucket.
4. Mailbox and Dashboard: improves Chinese labels, diagnostics, integration presentation, and regression coverage.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.19-l7 — 运维与本机用量
zh.summary: 新增 Runtime 状态诊断、更安全的集成入口和竖向本机 Codex 用量图表。
zh.content:
本地版本改进 Dashboard 运维、可选集成安全性和本机用量展示。
1. 运维状态：新增无感 Runtime 状态面板，展示协议、路由、活动会话、用量归因和最近检查时间。
2. 集成安全：服务不可用或功能关闭时隐藏或停用共享与可选集成入口。
3. 本机用量：每日文字行改为竖向柱状图，支持所有时间范围的紧凑标签，并在悬浮时快速显示时间段和用量。
4. Mailbox 与 Dashboard：改进中文界面、诊断信息、集成展示和回归测试。
